items.title: Her spiller barna fotball. Ser du dem?
items.excerpt: Sagene Avis møtte niåringene Olav, Håkon og Ulrik på fotballbanen til Nordpolen skole. Men der var det bare så vidt vi så hverandre.

items.title: Jessica (21) og Robin (20) får kjempehopp i kommunale avgifter
items.excerpt: Nå kjem rekninga for dei kostbare reinseanlegga kommunane rundt Oslofjorden er pålagde å bygge av staten. Det svir for innbyggarane.

items.title: Hutchinson's mission to fulfil self-penned prophecy
items.excerpt: Scotland's Willy Hutchinson is out to realise the dream he wrote about as a 13-year-old when he fights Joshua Buatsi for the vacant WBC light-heavyweight title this weekend.

items.title: Germany’s Gen Z protest riots spark debate on integration and bias
items.excerpt: Political debate about the recent Gen Z riots have raised the question: Can Germany talk about problems with integration without putting entire groups of people under suspicion?

items.title: WTA takes 'full responsibility' after Pegula calling Andreeva 'diva' aired
items.excerpt: The WTA says it takes "full responsibility" after private comments Jessica Pegula made to her coach about Mirra Andreeva were live-streamed by a courtside microphone.

items.title: Paraguay's President Santiago Pena resigns amid a bank crisis that froze millions of customers' accounts and sparked protests
items.excerpt: Paraguay's President Santiago Pena has resigned amid a crisis over his ties to collapsed lender Ueno. Millions of customers' accounts are frozen, with public pension and health care funds also tied up.
